tools.name: CC/iC Tools (soupday cc_blender_tools)
tools.role: CC5 import/rebuild in Blender; glTF export must enable 'Bake Materials for Export' so the custom CC shaders collapse to standard PBR; spring bones and facial drivers baked to keyframes before glTF

tools.name: R3F Export Prep
tools.role: Prepare and analyze scenes for optimized GLTF/GLB export to React Three Fiber (bl_info); analyzer + pre-flight checklist, instancing, merge static, apply-for-export, UV audit, mesh cleanup

tools.name: Web Export Prep
tools.role: Superseded by R3F Export Prep, keep disabled (operator/panel ids collide)

tools.name: NLA Batch Export
tools.role: Batch-exports NLA strips as individual FBX files (only custom add-on touching actions)

tools.name: Particle Hair to Mesh Tubes
tools.role: Converts particle hair systems into UV'd mesh tubes for real-time rendering

tools.name: GLBOptimizer
tools.role: Optimize your Scene for Web (manifest tagline); glTF-transform + server web-optimize step; needs KTX-Software

tools.name: R3F Studio Bridge
tools.role: Export assets to R3F Studio via WebSocket (manifest tagline); bridge stub

tools.name: SimpleBake
tools.role: Listed among his GLB tools (no further role stated in source)
tools.source: memory:/areas/3d-portfolio.md (iClone RLPy quirks / GLB tools entry)

tools.name: Assetify
tools.role: Listed among his GLB tools (no further role stated in source)

tools.name: UVPackmaster 3
tools.role: UV packing engine (manifest tagline); listed among his GLB tools

tools.name: gltf-transform CLI
tools.role: Universal compression tool; avatar GLB (morph targets) uses meshopt, mesh-only scene GLBs use Draco; never gltfpack

tools.name: KTX-Software (ktx / toktx)
tools.role: Texture compression for glTF export, required by the Optimize GLB Blender plugin

tools.name: Blender glTF 2.0 exporter (built-in)
tools.role: File > Export > glTF 2.0 (.glb), +Y up, shape keys + skinning + animations, 30fps sampling

tools.name: gltfjsx
tools.role: npx gltfjsx path/to/model.glb generates a JSX component file (-T for transform)

tools.name: @react-three/fiber (Canvas)
tools.role: React renderer hosting the GLB scene

tools.name: avatar-engine
tools.role: Viseme map, analyser lipsync, facial layers, gestures + R3F hooks; drives facial visemes live at runtime
